1.description: Fixed the tooltip of Ferocity to clarify it also works with enslaved demons.
Fixed the tooltips of Lone Wolf and Demonic Knowledge to clarify they do not work with dominated undead or enslaved demons.
Fixed an issue where Illumination could restore mana from more spells than indicated by the tooltip.

0.description: Fixed an issue where some bosses in botanica could drop items not in their loot tables.

8.description: [Pending Restart] The Charger questline's will now reward an item instead of a spell. This new item is added to vanity Collections and teaches you the Charger.
[Pending Restart] Dreadsteed questline will now reward an item instead of a spell. This new item is added to vanity Collections and teaches you the Dreadsteed.

7.description: [Area-52] Fixed an issue where Master of Shadows damage proc was not being triggered via your shadow bolt when consumed via nightfall.
Fixed an issue where Charred Bite Damage from Lucifur was not receiving the correct scaling. This fix should result in a damage increase.

5.description: [Mythic+ Scaling][Pending Restart] - Adjusted the stat scaling per level on Mythic+ Items that will bring them to a more well rounded state and more in line with raid tiers.
[Mythic+ Scaling][Pending Restart] - Increased the scaling per level on the Caster Weapons which should bring their Spell Power more in line.
[World Boss Loot] - Increased the weapon damage of all Heroic and Ascended world boss loot by 5.5% and 11% respectively.

7.description: Electrocute from Hydromancer now lasts for 2 sec, changed from 3.

0.description: Added Beginners Book of Ascension and Beginners Book of Artisans to Thelsamar, Sepulcher, Auberdine, Blood Watch and Tranquilien.
[Requires Launcher Update] You can now specify how many stacks of a Mystic Enchant should be used for a build in the Hero Architect. Existing builds will need to be updated by the Author.
[Mal'ganis] Ny'alotha Allseer will now be rewarded upon completion of running either Nightmare and Ironman or Nightmare and Survivalist together.

6.description: Fixed an issue where Stratholme on Mythic & Heroic would not give you reputation for the Argent Dawn.
Fixed an issue where Scholomance on Mythic & Heroic would not give you reputation for the Argent Dawn.
[Blackwing Lair] - Nefarian will now kill all Drakonids 60 seconds after the final drakonid is summoned.

0.description: Fixed an issue where groups would not get BG pops properly when there were matches available.
Fixed an issue in the rolling of loot from caches that could cause you to get the same item over and over.
Fire Nova is now usuable even when your Fire Totem is LOS.

5.description: [Mythic+ Itemization Changes] - Helm of the Grand Crusader now has Agility, Hit Rating and Attack Power similarly to Shadowcraft Cap, but does not have critical strike rating. Previously this item had an equal distribution of Strength, Agility, Stamina and Attack Power... Weird right?
[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] - Clever hat now has hit rating, high spell power and stamina instead of previously only having stamina and mp5.
[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] - Ragefury Eyepatch now has slightly more agility than before.
[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] - Eye of Rend now has slightly more strength than before.
[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] - Ghostshroud has been transformed into an item with expertise, agility and attack power instead of having low strength and high agility.
[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] Ring of Demonic Potency is now an item that has high stamina, defense and expertise rating. Previously it had 10 stamina and no other stat.

[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] Magma forged Band is now an item that has Attack Power and Expertise Rating and be found in both the Strength and Agility category. This ring fills a slot that was not yet fulfilled in the itemization changes. This ring previously had a mix of Strength and Agility without a clear identity or purpose.

[Mythic+ Itemization Changes] Band of Vigor is now an item that has Attack Power and Hit Rating and be found in both the Strength and Agility category. This ring fills a slot that was not yet fulfilled in the itemization changes. This ring previously had a mix of Strength and Agility without a clear identity or purpose.
Renamed One Punch to Will Smith.

7.description: [Spell Shredder] Fixed an issue where Elemental Shredder would be removed after being disarmed.
Fixed an issue where Slice and Ice would be removed after being disarmed.
[Pending Restart] The stun effect from The Bad Shepherd now lasts for 1.5 sec, changed from 2 sec.
[Pending Restart] Tainted Swipe now counts as a disease effect.
The Preservation heal from Prayer of Preservation has been increased by 15%.
[Pending Restart] Treants with Guardians of the Grove can no longer use Wild Growth.
Frozen Chaos now increases your Chaos Bolt damage versus players by 15%, changed from 5%.
[Lava Sweep] - Resetting the cooldown of Lava Sweep through Pyroblast with 5 stacks of Eruption will now also cause your next Lava Sweep to not incur a cooldown.
[Lava Sweep] - Lava Sweep can no longer be dodged or parried.
[Lava Sweep] - Fixed an issue in the "Sweeper" buff and Searing Lash buff from the Searing Rage RE not stacking simultaneously.
[Prophet of Wrath] Reduced the damage the Divine Arcane Blast and Arcane Missiles deals to players while Divine Illumination is active.
[Spell Shredder] Elemental Shredder Mortal Strike Damage Proc now deals 100% damage to players, increased from 70% damage to players.
[Spell Shredder] Elemental Rend now deals 100% damage to players, increased from 85% damage to players.
[Hoplite] Shield Strike now deals 75% damage to players, increased from 60% damage to players. This low PvP mod was necessary prior to Finisher Move Improvements.

[Hoplite] Phalanx Strike released with a significant PvP mod in an abundance of caution. Phalanx Strike will now increase PvP damage by 5% per stack, increased from 2% per stack. We will continue adjusting these PvP mods as feedback and data comes in.
[Fire Watch] Fire Watch Explosive Charge AOE now does 100% damage to players, increased from 80% damage to players.
[Fire Watch] Fire Watch Explosive Charge now does 100% damage to players, increased from 90% damage to players.
[Fire Watch] Fire Watch Fire Damage Proc now does 100% damage to players, increased from 95% damage to players.
[Beast and Blade] Increased the damage of Blade Beast to 10% per stack, increased from 5% per stack.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Survival Instincts now grants you 25% increased health, changed from 30%.
[Pending Restart] Last Stand now grants you 20% increased health, changed from 25%.
[Pending Restart] Concussion Blow now has a 4 sec duration, changed from 3.5.
[Pending Restart] Improved Kidney Shot now also increases all damage taken by 1/2/3% in addition to its previous effects.
[Pending Restart] Improved Disciplines no longer reduces the cooldown of Shockwave.

[Pending Restart] Thunderstruck now increases the duration of Shockwave by 0.33/0.66/1 sec, changed from 0.5/1/1.5, and it now reduces the cooldown of Shockwave by 5/10/15 sec in addition to its previous effects.
[Pending Restart] Shockwave now lasts for 3 sec, changed from 2.
[Malganis] While Missile Barrage is active your Arcane Missiles deals 10% reduced damage versus players.

6.description: [Scholomance] [Lorekeeper Polkelt] Pending Restart: Dark Plague now has a 3 seconds cool down.

5.description: [Chromie][Token of Prestige Exchange] - Chromie now offers the Hand of Nilganihmaht mount in exchange for Prestige Tokens. (Pending Restart)

7.description: Molten Mana from Lava Sweep will now also restore a flat mana amount in addition to scaling with attack power.
[Dark Surgeon] Fixed an issue where Rupture was not consuming the Dark Surgeon Buff.

[Lava Sweep] - The cooldown reset on Lava Sweep from casting Pyroblast when your Eruption is fully stacked will now proc on cast to smooth out the rotation instead of proccing on hit. (this should also help early when you are not hit capped)
[Lava Sweep] - Lava Sweep now does 90% weapon damage in AoE up from 80%.

6.description: Nefarian now drops two Raid Caches up from one to encourage heroes to finish the raid.
[Callboard Quests] - Adventurer's Contract (high-risk) will now reward a callboard cache.
[Callboard Quests] - A lesser known issue (high-risk) will now reward a callboard cache.
[Callboard Quests] - Proving Grounds: Skirmish will now reward a callboard cache.
[Callboard Quests] - Proving Grounds will now reward a callboard cache.
[Callboard Quests] - City Siege will now reward a loaded callboard cache.

8.description: [Pending Restart] - In addition to the Proof of Demise being able to be turned into Major Mattingly and Overlord Runthak, the description on the item now has more detailed information regarding the whereabouts of these NPCs.

[Malganis] [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Proof(s) of Demise were unable to be turned into Overlord Runthak (Orgrimmar) and Field Marshal Afrasiabi (Stormwind) as part of the Head of Nefarian questline.
[Malganis] - Fixed an issue where certain Dungeon Dailies would not appear on the callboard.

5.description: [Nozdormu][Marks of Ascension Exchange] - Nozdormu has new trinkets in stock in exchange for Marks of Ascension. These trinkets are meant to be a beginner trinket and supply you with PvE power.
Fixed a visual error where Mastercraft Warlord's Belt Buckle indicated it gave +12 Strength. The correct amount is +16 Strength.

0.description:
[Pending Restart] - Vendors who sell temporal contracts will now only show you temporal contracts for quests that are completable with temporal contracts.

Example: Going to Tiraxis with a "Proving Grounds" quest will only show you the temporal contract for Proving Grounds.
[High Risk] BWL Sanguine Recipes will now always drop from Crow's Cache. (Pending Restart)
Fixed an issue where some quests would still grant Bloody Spoils of War. They will correctly will reward a callboard cache now.
Essence of Blood is now correctly categorized under Profession quests.

7.description: You can now bring the proof of demise right to Major Mattingly or Overlord Runthak directly.
Added Major Mattingly and Overlord Runthak to Booty Bay.
[Knight of the Eclipse] - Fixed an issue where Solar Knight and Lunar Knight was not granting AP scaling to Wrath and Starfire.
[Lava Sweep] - Increased the "Sweep" range from 6 yards to 8 yards.
[Knight of the Eclipse] Fixed an issue where the Knightfall buff would be removed when shapeshifting and mounting.
Fixed an issue where Elemental Assassin had too high of a PvP mod not increasing the damage done by your shocks in PvP. It will now increase the damage of your shocks by up to 15% per stack in PvP.

[Tree of Wrath] It now requires Spirit Allocation to gain the bonus Nature Spell Power from Healing Spell Power. This change was necessary to ensure Tree of Wrath remains balanced and focusing on being a strong hybrid healer/dps.
[Dark Surgeon] Fixed an issue where Hippocratic Oath was not applying. You must re-equip the Legendary Enchant to activate the buff.
[Flamekeeper] - Increased the Attack Power scaling of Fireball and Pyroblast while using the Flamekeeper epic RE by 17.5% of its previous values.
[Frozen Chaos] - Fixed an issue where Frozen Chaos had an incorrect proc chance.
[Elemental Assassin] - Fixed an issue where Elemental Blades was not functioning in Arena.
[Master of Shadows] - Fixed an issue where Master of Shadows would no longer proc the damage buff when used through Nightfall.
[Lava Sweep] - Requires Launcher Update - Lava Sweep is now usable in Metamorphosis.

6.description: [Mythic+] [Pending Restart] Creatures Magic and Physical damage will now increase exponentially with the dungeons Mythic Level, previously increased linear. Damage will now increase slowly on lower Mythic Levels and starts to increase much faster on higher Mythic Levels.
[The Blood Furnace] [Pending Restart] Degraded Fel Orc Neophytes and Nascent Fel Orcs to level 60 down from 61 on Normal difficulty and 70 down from 71 on Heroic and Mythic difficulty.

[The Eye] [Void Reaver] Reduced the interval of Maintenance Modes periodic healing to 2 seconds down from 1 second, causing Void Reaver to restore a total of 10% of his maximum health per Maintenance, down from 20%.

5.description: [Malganis] - Ascended Raids will now also include a personal loot cache from heroic.
[Neural Silencer] buff will no longer be lost on death. (Pending Restart)

8.description: Pending restart, quest "The Essence of Blood" gave an incorrect amount of Mystic Orbs. Quest rewarded 23 and now rewards 25.

2.description: [League High Risk] [Pending Restart] These changes to vendor price and drop rates should ensure a healthier player to player High-Risk Material economy and AH fees are massively lowered and the ability for craftsmen to produce HR consumables and enchants is significantly improved. Happy Hunting!
[League High Risk] [Pending Restart] Significantly lowered the vendor cost of High-Risk materials to account for the massive increase in drop rates and chance to find rare and epic materials.
[League High Risk] [Pending Restart] More than doubled the drop chance of HR Materials.
